name: Zelio E-Mobility Limited
summary: Zelio E-Mobility Limited manufactures, assembles, and supplies electric vehicles. The comapny offers a range of electric two-wheelers such as Eeva, Gracy pro, Mystery, XMen, Little Gracy, Legender, Logix, and Gracy series under Zelio brand; and commercial electric three-wheelers such as Logix e-loader cargo series and butterfly passenger vehicles under Tanga brand. It also provides accessories, which includes smart chargers, vehicle accessories, and model-specific components; and batteries such as lithium-ion and graphene batteries.
